findings.description: Critical: `contracts/openapi/v1.1.yaml` `ExcludedAssignment.reason` is patterned as `^(lane|policy|catalog|roadmap|registry|cedar):[a-z0-9-]+$`, but design.md D5 step 5 still applies dg-00 catalog availability / modality / quota feasibility, and the live resolver today emits reasons such as `unavailable` and `quota:exhausted` (`agent-coordinator/src/model_routing/resolver.py` `feasibility_reason`). Those strings fail the new pattern, while `quota:` is not an allowed namespace at all. Spec only exemplifies `catalog:no-configured-lane`, so implementers have no remapping table and cannot satisfy both D5 and the OpenAPI pattern.
findings.resolution: Widen or version the reason grammar to include existing dg-00 reasons (`unavailable`, `quota:*`, and any retained free-form `exclusion_reason`), or explicitly require remapping into the new prefixes and list the canonical reason catalog in spec.md plus OpenAPI.

findings.description: Nit: Rule evaluation for an omitted/null `routing_profile` is unspecified. `contracts/openapi/v1.1.yaml` defaults `SelectModelRequest.routing_profile` to `null`, while `TaskRoutingProfile` fields themselves default to `read-only` / `headless` / `none` / `1` / `unknown` when an object is present. design.md D2/D3 and specs/task-routing/spec.md never say whether legacy callers that send only `task_signals.archetype` evaluate rules against those profile defaults or against absent profile signals. `{}` versus `null` therefore change matched rules and assignments without a SHALL.
findings.resolution: Add an explicit scenario: either null/omitted `routing_profile` is coerced to the typed defaults before rule matching, or profile-field predicates match only when the client supplied a profile object.
findings.existing_code:
- **WHEN** a caller sends only the dg-00 `task_signals.archetype` field
- **THEN** the request SHALL remain valid
- **AND** newly added input and output fields SHALL use additive defaults.

findings.description: Nit: design.md D4 says `RoutingService` loads `VendorRegistryService` once per request without `available_only` prefiltering, but the current registry `_cost_projection` path writes a `vendor_catalog_projection_miss` audit event for every missing/ambiguous lane model on every `list_vendors` call (`agent-coordinator/src/vendor_registry.py`). Under dg-04 that becomes one audit burst per `select_model`, competing with the authoritative link-only `routing_decision` event D7 depends on. Neither design, tasks.md, nor work-packages.yaml says to pass `audit=None`, reuse a short-lived snapshot, or rate-limit those misses.
findings.resolution: Record the intended registry audit posture in D4 (for example construct the in-process registry with `audit=None` for routing snapshots, or suppress/rate-limit projection-miss events on the select_model path) and add a regression that one select_model call does not emit per-lane miss audits.
findings.existing_code:
`RoutingService` injects/loads `VendorRegistryService` in process and requests all
lanes without `available_only` prefiltering so exclusion provenance is retained.

findings.description: Nit: Empty feasible-set behavior is contracted only in OpenAPI. `contracts/openapi/v1.1.yaml` 503 text invents detail `no-feasible-routing-assignment`, but specs/task-routing/spec.md has scenarios for `routing-registry-unavailable` and `routing-durability-unavailable` only, and design.md D5 never states the HTTP/MCP outcome when every lane/model pair is excluded. The live dg-00 service today raises `no feasible model-routing candidate`, so the renamed detail is neither justified nor test-pinned in the requirement set.
findings.resolution: Add a spec scenario that zero feasible exact assignments return HTTP 503 with a single pinned detail string (and the existing MCP 503 envelope), and align design.md plus OpenAPI to that string.
findings.existing_code:
'503':
          description: >
            Registry unavailable, no feasible exact lane/model assignment, or atomic
            decision/audit durability unavailable. The response detail distinguishes
            routing-registry-unavailable, no-feasible-routing-assignment, and
            routing-durability-unavailable.

findings.description: Optional: The dg-04 OpenAPI overlay weakens `weight_overrides` from the dg-00 typed `{w_quality,w_cost,w_latency}` object (`openspec/changes/add-adaptive-model-router/contracts/openapi/v1.yaml`) to a bare `{type: [object, "null"]}` in `contracts/openapi/v1.1.yaml`. Current Pydantic still uses `WeightOverrides` with `extra=forbid`. The overlay therefore under-specifies a field the runtime already validates strictly.
findings.resolution: Restore the dg-00 `weight_overrides` property schema in the v1.1 overlay, or explicitly mark the loosening as intentional.

findings.description: Optional: Honest local-fallback provenance is required by prose and tests but not by schema. design.md D8, specs/task-routing/spec.md 'Coordinator is unreachable', and tasks.md 4.2 require `source=local-static` with `persisted=false` and `durable_audit=false`, yet `RoutingProvenance` in `contracts/openapi/v1.1.yaml` allows contradictory combinations such as `source=local-static` with `persisted=true` or `durable_audit=true`.
findings.resolution: Add an OpenAPI `oneOf`/conditional schema (or a dedicated LocalRoutingProvenance type) that forces local-static provenance to `persisted=false` and `durable_audit=false`.

findings.description: FYI: The plan durably records decisions and link-only audit events, but it does not define operator-facing signals for routing failure modes such as counts/rates of `routing-registry-unavailable`, `no-feasible-routing-assignment`, `routing-durability-unavailable`, or local-fallback activations. Detection would rely on log/audit scraping unless added later.
findings.resolution: No change required for dg-04 scope; consider metrics/alerts in a follow-up if routing availability needs SLOs.

findings.description: Plan correctly keeps a single additive routing surface: proposal.md, design.md D1, specs/task-routing/spec.md, tasks.md 1.4, and contracts/README.md all forbid introducing `POST /route/task` and require extending only `POST /routing/select_model` plus `select_model_for_task`.
findings.existing_code:
This change does **not** create `POST /route/task`, score a second time, alter dispatch
execution, pin isolation precedence, or enforce a sandbox.

findings.description: Plan correctly requires in-process dg-01 `VendorRegistryService` exact lane-to-catalog association (including `base_url`), forbids name/publisher/fuzzy joins, applies registry feasibility before dg-00 `score_and_rank`, preserves dg-00 static fallback equality, and keeps dg-05/dg-06/dg-07 admission, approval, and sandbox enforcement out of scope (design.md D4–D5, D8–D9; specs/task-routing/spec.md registry and fallback requirements).
findings.existing_code:
Only feasible lane/model candidates enter
the existing `score_and_rank`; DG-04 does not duplicate quality, posterior, cost,
latency, headroom, or exploration math.

findings.description: Plan correctly makes local fallback provenance honest and coordinator durability atomic: specs/task-routing/spec.md requires `fallback=true`, `source=local-static`, `persisted=false`, `durable_audit=false`, and null catalog key; design.md D7 plus migration `042_atomic_routing_audit.sql` / tasks.md 3.3–3.5 require an awaited decision+audit RPC with `routing-durability-unavailable` rollback semantics rather than fire-and-forget audit.
findings.existing_code:
- **THEN** the local helper SHALL return the normal assignment shape with
  `fallback=true`, `source=local-static`, `persisted=false`, and
  `durable_audit=false`

findings.description: Plan package DAG is executable and non-overlapping after revision 2: `wp-transports-fallback` depends on both `wp-contract-config` and `wp-policy-service`, write scopes separate contracts/policy/transport files, and `wp-integration` depends on the implementation packages. Parallelizability is intentionally serialized after contracts rather than racing API models against transport tests.
